caption: The drawing depicts a single brown coat, shown from the back and slightly to the left, occupying the majority of the space on a cream-colored background. The coat is detailed with realistic shading to indicate folds and texture, and features a collar, long sleeves, and two vertical pleats running down from the waist to the hem. There are two visible buttons at the waist level, positioned above shallow horizontal flaps. On the right side of the drawing, there is a smaller, simple line sketch of the same coat, shown from the front view with minimal detail, indicating the overall shape and basic features without any color or shading. The composition is sparse, with significant blank space around the objects.
title: Shaker Man's Coat
